thread:
Alex: quick async pulse — where are we on KV eviction tuning + kernel microbatch PR? need to call out owners and next milestone.
Priya: I pushed the eviction TTL prototype yesterday, PR at https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482. tag: @Sam for perf review.
Sam: saw the PR, glanced through. two small things: (1) update the eviction metric label, (2) potential race when hotpath marks deleted entries. will do a deeper pass tomorrow.
Maria: heads-up — perf dashboard showed a 12% tail-lat increase on the nightly canary after the last kernel commit (kernel#fa3b). linking: https://dash.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-latency?range=24h :eyes:
Alex: thanks. @Maria can you confirm region and model mix for that canary? want to know if it's batch-heavy or seq-heavy.
Maria: canary was eu-west2, mix skewed toward long-seq gen (avg 800 tokens), batch size distribution shows small batches still dominant.
Ethan: adding context: the kernel patch changed the attention kernel fallback for long sequences; could be CPU/GPU kernel switch noise. I have a repro harness if folks want to run: `./tools/repro --seq 800 --batch-dist small`.
Priya: noted. Sam — if race fix is quick, can we land eviction TTL then run a targeted canary with the harness? want to measure tail specifically for long-seq traffic.
Sam: yes, I can land the label change + race guard today. after that I suggest a controlled canary: 10% traffic to dedicated pool with KV TTL=30s vs baseline 60s.
Alex: owners: eviction TTL -> Priya; kernel microbatch regression -> Sam + Ethan; canary orchestration -> Maria. milestone: get canary metrics in 48h, decide rollback or ship.
Maria: will schedule canary in eu-west2 in the 10:00UTC window, will attach dashboards and automated checks.
Ethan: quick ask on metrics: can we add `kv.evicted_per_min` and `kv.eviction_latency_ms` to the per-route breakdown? I can add a grafana panel if the metrics exist.
Priya: `kv.evicted_per_min` already emitted, `kv.eviction_latency_ms` is missing — I'll add it in the next patch.
Sam: PR link for kernel microbatch change (for visibility): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/499 — perf tests updated, CI flaky on macos runner unrelated.
Alex: code review pinged: @Sam please request review from @Maria and @Priya when ready. Also add an entry in the rollout doc: `/docs/runbooks/rollout-kernel.md` with rollback steps.
Maria: ack — will add canary check: if p99 latency > baseline * 1.25 for 30m, auto-rollback. ops-bot will post status to this thread.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled at 1779043200 for eu-west2. Monitoring hooks: latency-p99, error-rate, kv-hit-rate. Will post intermediate updates.
Ethan: small instrumentation snippet I ran locally that might help (drop into kernel debug):
```
// sample p99 tracker
atomic<int64_t> tokens_processed = 0;
if (tokens_processed % 1e6 == 0) log_metric("kernel.tokens_checkpoint", tokens_processed);
```
Priya: nice. also adding a perf test case for 800-token sequences in `tests/perf/long_seq` so we can gate PRs.
Alex: timeline recap — today: Sam lands fixes; Priya lands metric + TTL patch; Maria schedules canary; Ethan runs harness verification; ops-bot posts canary results. Decision point within 48h.
Sam: landed small fixes, waiting on CI. tagging @Maria for canary once green. :thumbsup:
Maria: canary started (10% traffic). ops-bot will post the first 15m snapshot in 20m.
ops-bot: Canary snapshot (t+15m): p50 +3%, p95 +6%, p99 +14% vs baseline; kv-hit-rate stable; no errors.
Alex: that's borderline — p99 up 14% but our threshold is 25%. keep running and let the 1h snapshot decide.
Priya: I'm going to reduce TTL to 20s on the canary variant to see if eviction pressure reduces long-tail. I'll coordinate with Maria before applying.
Maria: applying TTL=20s now to canary. will watch dashboards.
ops-bot: Canary snapshot (t+45m): p50 +1%, p95 +2%, p99 +7%; kv-hit-rate slight dip (~1.2%).
Alex: good. looks like TTL tweak helped. next steps: stabilize metric panels, merge PRs after 72h of steady canary, and schedule a formal postmortem/notes in the runtime retro doc.
Sam: will post a short PR summary in the changelog and link perf graphs.
Priya: created perf metric PR and added `kv.eviction_latency_ms`. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/88
Maria: thanks all. if anyone needs to run isolated repro let me know — I can open a dedicated test pool.
Alex: thanks team — will follow up after canary completes. if anything spikes, @channel escalate here. :rocket:
